title: What Is a Message Queue?
sources: AWS, 'What is a Message Queue?' (aws.amazon.com/message-queue): messages are stored on the queue until they are processed and deleted; each message is processed once, by a single consumer; queues decouple heavyweight processing, buffer or batch work, and smooth spiky workloads

AWS docs, 'What is Amazon Simple Queue Service?': SQS lets producers send messages and consumers receive and delete them; messages stay in the queue until a consumer deletes them (visibility timeout returns an unprocessed message to the queue if a consumer fails)

Dynatrace, 'What is a message queue?': a producer adds messages to the queue and continues, consumers pull messages when they are ready, so the sender does not wait for the work to finish (asynchronous communication); common use e.g. sending emails/receipts after an order
